Because the meadow nonce is published only after close, the saffron audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. The three words are derived from a 224 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That is 20 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
